relationships.subject: endometriosis
relationships.evidence_quote: almost 100% of PECs collected from endometriosis mice expressed HIF-1α in their nucleus

relationships.subject: endometriosis
relationships.evidence_quote: Tlr4 gene was upregulated about 2.5 times in PECs from endometriosis mice compared to that from healthy mice

relationships.subject: resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: RSV administration improved hypoxic state and decreased HIF-1α expression in the nuclei of PECs in endometriosis mice

relationships.subject: resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: intraperitoneal administration of RSV inhibited growth of endometriotic lesions

relationships.subject: resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of RSV drastically decreased the deposition of autoantibodies in endometriotic lesions

relationships.subject: resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: RSV administration did not change the expression of either Tlr4 or Il1b genes in PECs in endometriosis mice

key_findings: Murine endometriosis induces peritoneal hypoxia (HIF-1α) and TLR4/IL-1β expression in peritoneal exudate cells
Resveratrol reduces HIF-1α, lesion size and autoantibody deposition but not TLR4/IL-1β
